*[Bug 19133] A new matrix method for aperm*
<https://bugs.r-project.org/show_bug.cgi?id=19133>

Kurt Hornik (<mailto:Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at|Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at>) changed:

           What    |Removed                     |Added
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                 CC|                            |Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at

--- Comment #4 from Kurt Hornik (<mailto:Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at|Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at>) ---
In principle, aperm.default() is all C code, so I guess if we want to
special case matrix transpose we should do this via C as well, i.e.,
have the code underlying .Internal(aperm(...)) call the code underlying
.Internal(t.default(...)).  I have not taken a closer look at this yet
though.

I did some simple timings, in which even directly calling the proposed
aperm.matrix() was never markedly faster than using aperm.default(), and
sometimes markedly slower ...
